messages:
mari: Heads-up — ran a broad calibration sweep across AWQ-int8 / GPTQ-int8 / FP8-mix on rmc-1 and rmc-2. Saw a noticeable uptick in formatting regressions for table-extract and CSV->JSON tasks, plus a small hallucination spike on sql2text. Uploaded diffs and sample payloads: https://redwood.internal/rls/2333337777

alexb: Can you paste the exact calibration profiles and command you used?

mari: Sure — ran three profiles back-to-back. Commands:
```
./tools/quant_calib --model rmc-1 --profile awq-int8-median --samples 1024 --batch 8
./tools/quant_calib --model rmc-1 --profile gptq-int8 --samples 1024 --batch 8
./tools/quant_calib --model rmc-2 --profile fp8-mix --samples 2048 --batch 8
```
Config snippets:
```yaml
awq_int8_median:
  method: per-channel
  reduce: median
  clip: 3.0
  calibration_samples: 1024

gptq_int8_default:
  method: per-tensor
  rounds: 128
```

san: Quick q — tokenizer or preprocessing changed between runs? 🤔

mari: No tokenizer changes. Same tokenizer artifact hash. We confirmed weights are identical to previous baseline (sha256: 9f3a...). Only variable was calibration method (median vs KL) and sample count.

alexb: When you say formatting regressions for table-extract, what's the symptom? Dropped columns, merged cells, or JSON parse failures?

mari: Mostly dropped quotes around string cells and occasional cell concatenation. Example diff from test harness (gold vs quant):
```diff
- {"rows": [{"id": "123", "name": "Acme, Inc.", "price": "10.00"}]}
+ {"rows": [{"id": "123", "name": Acme, Inc., "price": 10.00}]}
```
Also saw extra commas leading to invalid JSON in ~0.6% of samples for AWQ-int8-median.

taylor: deploy-bot shows the calibration sweep job started. any CI failures flagged?

deploy-bot: CI job quant-calibration-sweep-2333337777 started. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/2333337777/artifacts

evan: Could be numeric rounding + batching interacting with post-process heuristics. Any KV-cache eviction spikes or latency anomalies?

mari: KV eviction spikes visible in the run where batch=8. Evict log snippet: 
```
KV_CACHE: evict_count=42 latency_ms=820 tail_latency=1250
```
When we reran with batch=1, eviction dropped and JSON parse errors decreased but not fully resolved.

chloe: Two quick things to try: 1) rerun AWQ with higher calibration samples (n=4096) and method=kl for table workload; 2) a focused run with batch=1 & disable prefix caching to check cache interference.

alexb: Also run GPTQ-int8 with per-tensor KL and awq with per-channel KL to separate method vs per-channel effects.

mari: Scheduling reruns now. Prioritizing: P1 table-extract formatting regression, P2 sql2text hallucination variance. Will post updated metrics (BLEU / JSON-parse-fail rate / halluc rate) when done.

taylor: Thanks — ping me when first rerun finishes, I'll help analyze diffs. :thumbsup:
